author: Affirmate Administrative

title.en: Setting up a PT PMA in Indonesia: document checklist
title.id: Mendirikan PT PMA di Indonesia: daftar dokumen

excerpt.en: What a foreign investor usually prepares before incorporating a limited liability company in Indonesia, and where an administrative partner fits in.
excerpt.id: Apa yang biasanya disiapkan investor asing sebelum mendirikan perseroan terbatas di Indonesia, dan di mana peran mitra administrasi.

en: A PT PMA (Perseroan Terbatas Penanaman Modal Asing) is the standard vehicle for foreign shareholders operating in Indonesia. The incorporation itself is handled by a notary and registered with the Ministry of Law, but most of the preparation happens before that step.

Shareholders typically prepare: passports or company registration documents for each shareholder, a decision on the business classification (KBLI) that matches the planned activity, the registered office address, the composition of directors and commissioners, and the authorised and paid-up capital in line with current investment rules.

After the deed is issued, the company still needs its Business Identification Number (NIB) through the OSS system, a tax number (NPWP), bank accounts, and, where relevant, sector licences and work permits for expatriate staff.

Affirmate Administrative coordinates these steps with the notary, the licensing authorities and the immigration partner, so the shareholders deal with one team from the first document to the first work permit.
id: PT PMA (Perseroan Terbatas Penanaman Modal Asing) adalah bentuk badan usaha standar bagi pemegang saham asing yang beroperasi di Indonesia. Pendiriannya ditangani notaris dan didaftarkan ke Kementerian Hukum, tetapi sebagian besar persiapan terjadi sebelum tahap itu.

Pemegang saham biasanya menyiapkan: paspor atau dokumen pendaftaran perusahaan tiap pemegang saham, keputusan klasifikasi usaha (KBLI) yang sesuai kegiatan yang direncanakan, alamat kantor terdaftar, susunan direksi dan komisaris, serta modal dasar dan disetor sesuai ketentuan investasi yang berlaku.
Setelah akta terbit, perusahaan masih memerlukan Nomor Induk Berusaha (NIB) melalui sistem OSS, NPWP, rekening bank, dan bila relevan izin sektor serta izin kerja bagi staf ekspatriat.

Affirmate Administrative mengoordinasikan langkah-langkah ini dengan notaris, instansi perizinan, dan mitra keimigrasian, sehingga pemegang saham berurusan dengan satu tim dari dokumen pertama hingga izin kerja pertama.
